note: [L] gets the inverse derivative bounds by differentiating X⁻¹X=1 in YM.Stationary.Jam.rebounds, lifted to families in Fiesta.inv, and gets q_a = ik_a + O(κ²) from YM.Stationary.shrimper. The difference is packaging: the bounds use a general weight and scale T, not the explicit powers (κ+μ)^{-2,-3,-4}.

lemma inv (h : Fiesta ρ T X) (hp : ∀ i,0<T i ∧ IsUnit (X i 0).det) (hx : ∃ A : ℝ,0≤A∧ ∀ i,vflux (X i 0)⁻¹≤ A / T i) : Fiesta ρ (fun i => (T i)⁻¹) (fun i z=> (X i z)⁻¹) := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hk,hU⟩ := h; obtain ⟨B,hB,hX⟩ := hx; refine ⟨inverseBill A B,by unfold inverseBill; positivity,fun i=>⟨(hk i).1,inv_nonneg.mpr (hk i).2⟩,fun i=>?_⟩
  rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]; exact (hU i).rebounds (hp i).2 (hX i) (hp i).1 (hk i).1

proof_context.conclusion: If a family X has weighted derivative (Jam) bounds at scale T and its inverse at zero is bounded by A/T, then the inverse family has weighted bounds at scale T⁻¹; via Jam.rebounds this comes from differentiating X⁻¹X=1.

lemma shrimper (i : Axis) : Rays 2 (fun p : Track => Exterior.q (axes p) i - Complex.I*(p i:ℂ)) := by
  let L : Track→L[ℝ] ℂ := Complex.ofRealCLM ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.proj i
  let T : Track →ℂ := fun p => Complex.exp (L p *Complex.I)
  let K : Track→L[ℝ] ℂ := Complex.I • L
  refine twin_shear ?_ fun p=> ?_
  · apply ContDiffAt.analyticAt
    unfold q; apply ContDiffAt.sub; swap; exact K.contDiff.contDiffAt
    let f : Track→ℂ := fun p=> Complex.I * (axes p i)
    apply ContDiffAt.sub _ contDiffAt_const; refine ContDiffAt.comp (x:=0) (g:=Complex.exp) (f:=f) ?_ K.contDiff.contDiffAt
    exact (by fun_prop)
  have hp : ∀ᶠ u : ℝ in cutRay, (u:ℂ)⁻¹ * (q (axes (u • p)) i - Complex.I*((u • p) i:ℂ))=(u:ℂ)⁻¹*q (axes (u • p)) i -Complex.I*(p i:ℂ) := by
    filter_upwards [(self_mem_nhdsWithin : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in cutRay,t≠0)] with t ht; change t≠0 at ht; simp; field_simp [ht]
  have hx := (qPitch i p).sub_const (Complex.I*(p i:ℂ)); rw [sub_self] at hx; exact hx.congr' (EventuallyEq.symm hp)

proof_context.conclusion: q_a(p) - i p_a vanishes to order 2.
